content: Good morning, this is Officer Martin from the IRS Investigations Unit. I am calling regarding irregularities connected to your recent tax filings.
Oh my, I don't understand. I thought I paid my taxes this year.
According to our records, your Social Security number has been linked to suspicious tax activity, which is a violation of federal law.
I don't know anything about that. Is my Social Security okay? Will I lose my benefits?
Right now, your Social Security number has been temporarily suspended, and unless this situation is resolved, you may face further penalties, including the loss of federal benefits.
I'm really scared. I can't afford to lose my checks. What do I have to do?
If this issue is not taken care of immediately, a warrant for your arrest could be issued, and your driver's license will be revoked.
Please, don't do that! I can't go to jail. I don't drive much, but I need my license for my medicine.
To avoid arrest and reinstate your Social Security number, you need to verify your identity and settle the investigation fee today.
How do I do that? What do you need from me?
You must purchase government-approved gift cards from your nearest pharmacy or department store. This is the only way to process your payment securely and quickly.
Gift cards? I've never done that before. Which ones am I supposed to get?
You will need to buy Target or Apple iTunes gift cards, totaling $1,400. After you purchase them, do not speak to anyone about this investigation until it is closed.
That's a lot of money for me. Can't I pay with a check or bank card?
The IRS is only accepting payment through these cards due to the urgency of your case. Checks or bank transfers will not be processed in time to stop legal action.
Okay, I guess I can go now. What do I do after I get the cards?
Once you have the cards, call me back at this number. I will instruct you to read the numbers on the back of each card so we can verify your payment.
Alright, I'll try to get to the store now. Just please don't let anything happen to my Social Security.
If you follow my instructions precisely, your benefits will remain active and your name will be cleared. Do not delay.
